map.时效中断后，自中断事由消除之日起重新计算（《民法典》第195条）。: After interruption, the period restarts from the date the interruption ground ends (Article 195 of the Civil Code).
map.《民法典》第188条：向人民法院请求保护民事权利的诉讼时效期间为三年。法律另有规: Article 188 of the Civil Code: the limitation period for requesting a people's court to protect civil rights is three years, unless the law provides otherwise. It runs from the date the right holder knows or should know of the damage to the right and of the obligor. However, no protection is granted after twenty years from the date of damage, save in special circumstances where the court may extend the period on application.
map.⚠️ 本工具按\"起算日 + 时效期间 = 届满日\"的对应日方法计算，届满当日: ⚠️ This tool uses the corresponding-date method: start date + limitation period = expiry date; the expiry date itself is the last day, expiring at 24:00. If it falls on a holiday, it is extended by law to the first working day after the holiday. Results are reference only and not legal advice.
map.买卖合同欠款到期未还，从履行期限届满之日起算 3 年普通时效，计算届满日以免丧失: For an unpaid sales contract debt, the general 3-year period starts from the expiry of the performance deadline; compute the expiry date so you do not lose the right to win.

map.涉及最长保护期（20 年）的，自权利受损害之日起超过 20 年法院不予保护。: For the maximum protection period (20 years), no court protection is granted once more than 20 years have passed since the date of damage.
map.约定还款日 2023-01-01，时效自次日起算 3 年，届满日为 2026-0: Agreed repayment date 2023-01-01; the 3-year period starts the next day and expires on 2026-01-01. If no suit is filed and no interruption occurs before that date, the claim may be lost to expiry.
map.若 2024-06-01 通过短信/书面催款并保留证据，时效自该日起重新计算 3: If a demand is made by text or in writing on 2024-06-01 and evidence is kept, the 3-year period restarts from that date, with a new expiry of 2027-06-01.
map.哪些情形会导致时效中断？: What circumstances interrupt the limitation period?
map.权利人向义务人提出履行请求、义务人同意履行义务、权利人提起诉讼或申请仲裁，以及与: A demand for performance by the right holder, the obligor's consent to perform, filing suit or applying for arbitration by the right holder, and other equivalent acts all interrupt the limitation and restart it.
